meta.title: Periodic Model Picker
meta.description: Replaces the composer model seat with a periodic-table picker and adds a Model table page to Settings. Each model has one row for its display name, icon, element and color; elements that no model occupies stay gray. The host generates one-sentence model descriptions with the configured LLM, cached under the harness home. Selecting a tile previews it; one button switches the session's model. No message is sent.
